Mechanism of the missing parameter name: serde does not prepend struct-field names to errors raised inside custom/untagged deserializers, and the clone uses no serde_path_to_error anywhere (grep zero hits); derive-generated errors on the same struct DO carry the field name (observed 'missing field `ids`' in idtype_002), so the naming gap is specific to custom-deserializer fields like with_payload. The custom expecting text is itself a deliberate diagnostics investment (it accurately describes the accepted type domain, matching the doc's boolean/array/include-exclude forms) but there is NO comment or maintainer annotation declaring the omission of the parameter name intentional. Note (factual, from the excerpt): the source doc comment on PointRequestInternal.with_payload reads 'Default is true.' while WithPayloadInterface::default() = Bool(false) — a defaults-face nuance belonging to the sibling defaults candidates, recorded here only because it sits inside the examined excerpt.
